targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, kind AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM telemetry_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, source AS metric, sum(count) AS value FROM download_counts WHERE $__timeFilter(day::timestamptz) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Failed installs by addon and code

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.slug, e.kind, e.error_code, count(*) AS events FROM telemetry_events e JOIN addons a ON a.id = e.addon_id WHERE e.error_code IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(e.created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT launcher_version, count(DISTINCT install_id) AS installations FROM telemetry_events WHERE install_id IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY installations DESC

SELECT a.slug, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'install') AS installs, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'update') AS updates, count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'rollback') AS rollbacks FROM telemetry_events e JOIN addons a ON a.id = e.addon_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY installs DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: API requests per hour by client

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, client AS metric, sum(count) AS value FROM api_request_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Launcher downloads
panels.description: Downloads of the launcher's release files on GitHub over all versions, self-updates included; one point per hourly poll.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, downloads AS "downloads of every version" FROM launcher_counts WHERE downloads IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Launchers active in the last 30 days
panels.description: Launchers of any version that installed or updated an addon in the 30 days before each hourly poll and send an installation ID; the number on /stats.

targets.rawSql: SELECT at AS time, active_30d AS "active launchers (30 days)" FROM launcher_counts WHERE $__timeFilter(at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Active launchers this hour
panels.description: Launchers that asked the platform something since the start of this hour, by platform and version; it starts at zero every hour. Only launchers that send their installation ID count; versions before 0.6.4 name no platform (unknown).

targets.rawSql: SELECT os AS "Platform", version AS "Version", count(*) AS "Launchers" FROM launcher_active WHERE hour = date_trunc('hour', now()) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1, 2

panels.title: Active launchers today
panels.description: Launchers active since midnight (Europe/Berlin), by platform and version; it starts at zero every day. A launcher updated during the day counts under both versions.

targets.rawSql: SELECT os AS "Platform", version AS "Version", count(DISTINCT install_id) AS "Launchers" FROM launcher_active WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin') AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC, 1, 2

panels.title: Launcher versions over time

targets.rawSql: SELECT hour AS time, version AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM launcher_active WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Launchers active per hour by version: how fast a new release replaces the old ones.

panels.title: Failures per launcher version

targets.rawSql: SELECT launcher_version AS "Launcher", count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind IN ('install', 'update', 'rollback')) AS "Done", count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind IN ('install_failed', 'update_failed')) AS "Failed", round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind IN ('install_failed', 'update_failed')) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS "Failed %" FROM telemetry_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.description: Installs, updates and rollbacks in the time range per launcher version, and the share that failed. A broken release shows here first.

panels.title: Failed share per platform and day

targets.rawSql: SELECT day::timestamptz AS time, os AS metric, round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE kind IN ('install_failed', 'update_failed')) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) AS value FROM telemetry_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Hours active per launcher and day

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', hour) AS time, os AS metric, round(count(*)::numeric / count(DISTINCT install_id), 1) AS value FROM launcher_active WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: On average, in how many hours of a day a launcher asked the platform something, by platform: how long launchers stay open.

panels.title: Installs and updates per addon and day

targets.rawSql: WITH top AS (SELECT addon_id FROM telemetry_events WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND kind IN ('install', 'update') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT e.day::timestamptz AS time, a.slug::text AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM telemetry_events e JOIN top USING (addon_id) JOIN addons a ON a.id = e.addon_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at) AND e.kind IN ('install', 'update') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The ten addons with the most installs and updates in the time range, per day.

panels.title: Risers of the week

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.slug AS "Addon", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.day > current_date - 7) AS "Last 7 days", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.day <= current_date - 7) AS "7 days before", count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.day > current_date - 7) - count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.day <= current_date - 7) AS "Gain" FROM telemetry_events e JOIN addons a ON a.id = e.addon_id WHERE e.day > current_date - 14 AND e.kind IN ('install', 'update') AND a.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.day > current_date - 7) > 0 ORDER BY "Gain" DESC LIMIT 20

panels.description: Installs and updates of the last seven days against the seven days before, biggest gain first. Ignores the time range.

panels.title: Addons without a release for 60 days

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.slug AS "Addon", max(v.published_at) AS "Last release", (current_date - max(v.published_at)::date) AS "Days" FROM addons a LEFT JOIN versions v ON v.addon_id = a.id WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.blocked_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1 HAVING max(v.published_at) IS NULL OR max(v.published_at) < now() - interval '60 days' ORDER BY 2 NULLS FIRST

panels.description: Listed addons whose newest version is older than 60 days, or that have none. Ignores the time range.

panels.title: Rollbacks by addon

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.slug AS "Addon", e.version AS "Back to", count(*) AS "Rollbacks", max(e.created_at) AS "Last" FROM telemetry_events e JOIN addons a ON a.id = e.addon_id WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at) AND e.kind = 'rollback' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Launchers that installed a version older than the newest by hand. Many rollbacks to one version hint at a broken newer release.
